In detail

Searches for Vicalvaro's historic core specifically returned mostly administrative, cultural and real-estate content (municipal festival announcements, housing listings), plus one multi-district narcopiso operation from several months ago that named Vicalvaro district generally alongside Ciudad Lineal, Centro and Usera without pinpointing which barrio within Vicalvaro was affected. Given that ambiguity, no specific safety concern is attributed to this exact barrio. Sources checked: Facebook/Noticias Para Municipios (multi-district narcopiso operation, not barrio-specific); Ayuntamiento de Madrid, Noticias de Vicalvaro (administrative/cultural, non-safety); No barrio-specific incident coverage found.
